SELECT A.CODE AS NATION_CODE , A.CODE_NAME AS NATION_NAME FROM CODE_DTL A WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND A.CATEGORY = 'NA' AND A.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FTA_APPLY_NATION B WHERE B.NATION_CODE = A.CODE AND B.FTA_CODE = #{fta_code})
ORDER BY A.CODE_NAME

SELECT A.NATION_CODE , B.CODE_NAME AS NATION_NAME , A.EFFECT_DATE FROM FTA_APPLY_NATION A INNER JOIN CODE_DTL B ON A.NATION_CODE = B.CODE AND B.CATEGORY = 'NA' AND B.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} WHERE FTA_CODE = #{fta_code} ORDER BY B.CODE_NAME
